decisions.reason: Cites the 42 session.events reads in plugin-source-excerpt.js, the crash chain in crash-stack.txt, the 0.1.2-alpha.4 changelog removal and seq/eventAt/snapshotEvents replacement; explains the undefined read iterated into a non-iterable TypeError at apply time.

Uses npm-install-output.txt: alpha.5 satisfies ^0.1.2-alpha.2 (>=0.1.2-alpha.2 <0.2.0-0); npm only compares declared version ranges, never API existence, runtime behavior, or whether the author tested anything.

At least six distinct classes: removed/renamed member, changed signature/shape of surviving members, behavioral/default changes, event/wire drift, composition-plane failures, type-vs-runtime divergence — well beyond the two required.

Requires testing the top of the declared range (or bounding it below the removal) plus narrowing the peer range and a runtime feature-detection guard with correct old/new paths; explains engines/metadata cannot encode API presence.
Concrete range→corridor→release-notes→npm-pack-and-grep procedure targeting session.events, tied to this incident and its alpha.4 boundary; notes green npm checks are insufficient.

caps.reason: Affirms the removal and concludes peer satisfaction is only an ordering/metadata fact, never proof of runtime compatibility.
